The difference between the billed 8.20 excess km and the 7.53 km segment (~$0.94) is corridor/map-matching mileage not attributable to any measured segment and is not refunded [F4][F3][RD-2]. No account flag: the trace fixes route_disputes_upheld_90d = 0 [F18], so RD-6's ≥1 condition is unmet, and profile facts could not decide the deviation in any event [RD-6]. Refund to be issued as a Ryde voucher [NS-7].
